findings.passage: In Congress, Jace Yarbrough will champion national reciprocity on concealed carry permits so law-abiding gun owners can lawfully carry when traveling over state lines, and a repeal of the National Firearms Act - an outdated law twisted by Democrats to arbitrarily infringe on our freedoms.
findings.note: Campaign priorities page (written in the third person) promises national concealed-carry reciprocity and repeal of the National Firearms Act. Page is undated.
subjects: repeal of the National Firearms Act

findings.passage: Liberals in Washington DC will stop at nothing to restrict and control our 2nd amendment rights, and they don't even try to hide their intentions.
findings.note: Campaign priorities page, section 'Protecting our 2nd Amendment': says federal gun restrictions threaten Second Amendment rights.

findings.passage: A proud gun-owner, Jace still treasures his grand-dads .410 and long barrel .22 and owns firearms for home defense.
findings.note: Campaign priorities page: describes his own gun ownership.
